amendment_reason: Independent implementation review found that Task Packet V2 requires the validated file-identity digest in the pass terminal although V4 did not list it, and that manifest-listed identity checks alone did not reject unlisted stage-tree entries.
scope: Engineering evidence schema and exact stage/final tree membership only. No source selection, price row, signal, arm, execution, cost, economic gate, validation, holdout, MQL5, Model 0, promotion or deployment semantic changes.
contract_precedence: V4, V5 and V6 remain binding except that this addendum replaces only V4 attempt_terminal_pass with attempt_terminal_pass_v2 and adds the exact_tree_membership rules below.

attempt_terminal_pass_v2.identity_binding: validated_file_identities_sha256 must equal the independent validation receipt value and the supervisor pre-publish exact listed-shard identity digest.

exact_tree_membership.inspection_method: lstat/scandir membership and identity checks only; no Parquet payload open or decode by supervisor
exact_tree_membership.root_entry_rules: DESIGN is the only directory. The other six entries are regular non-reparse single-link files. Missing or extra entries are fatal.
exact_tree_membership.design_entry_rule: DESIGN contains exactly 1297 non-reparse date directories whose names equal the strictly increasing frozen selection-manifest date set; no file or additional directory is allowed.
exact_tree_membership.date_directory_rule: Each DESIGN/{date} directory contains exactly one entry named h1_1200.parquet. It is a regular non-reparse single-link file and is the same file identity bound by validated_file_identities_sha256.
exact_tree_membership.mismatch_policy: SOURCE_PROJECTION_FAILED_ENGINEERING_NO_MARKET_VERDICT; publish forbidden before rename, and any post-rename mismatch produces a failure terminal without an economic or market verdict.
